sharedPromptConstraints: Original creature; Orakyn supplied only as pixel-art style reference; right-facing full-body battle pose; limited palette; selective dark outline; flat chroma key; no text, logos, franchise traits, or external character references.
notes: The built-in image tool was used because the active Codex image-generation workflow requires it. PixelLab credentials remain local and unused by the browser. Flat-key sources were chroma-processed; outputs with model-native alpha were preserved directly. All sprites were resized to canonical 128×128 RGBA and validated for transparent corners.
